title: Order II Rule 2 CPC — Whole claim

content.overview: Sue the whole claim on that cause of action. An omitted slice is barred later unless leave was taken for an omitted relief.
content.study: The bar is same cause of action, not every later dispute with the same defendant. Pair with Section 11 when the first suit went to trial.
